## Summary / Кратко

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change / Тип изменения

- [ ] Dashboard/UI
- [ ] Python analysis
- [ ] Data/workbook
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Methodology

## Research Impact / Влияние на исследование

Does this change preprocessing, thresholds, formulas, data provenance, or interpretation?

## Checks / Проверки

- [ ] `npm run test:i18n`
- [ ] Python script checked where relevant
- [ ] README/docs local links checked
- [ ] Screenshots updated where relevant

## Data and Licensing / Данные и лицензии

- [ ] No new third-party data/content
- [ ] New data/content provenance documented
- [ ] `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` updated if needed

## Notes / Примечания

List warnings, skipped checks, or follow-up work.
